name: HC26a: Total eligible.
description: Total eligible at 6 months post ART initiation. Counts unique active ART patients whose six-month anniversary after ART initiation falls within the reporting period.
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f

sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT r.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_patients_latest_regimen r
WHERE r.art_start_date IS NOT NULL

  AND DATE_ADD(r.art_start_date, INTERVAL 6 MONTH) >= :startDate
  AND DATE_ADD(r.art_start_date, INTERVAL 6 MONTH)
      < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary s
      WHERE s.patient_id = r.patient_id
  )

  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
      WHERE a.patient_id = r.patient_id
        AND (
            (
                a.encounter_date >= :startDate
                AND a.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
            )
            OR a.return_visit_date > :endDate
        )
  );
